headline.description: 'N Reasons ...' formula, 8-14 words. Name the audience when the ad names one (e.g. 'N Reasons Busy Parents Are Switching to Peak Saunas'). N must match the number of entries in reasons.

proof_row.description: Optional 3-stat proof row directly under the dek. Only verified claims: live Judge.me rating and count, warranty term, free shipping. Omit entirely rather than pad it out -- never invent a fourth stat, and never include a review stat when facts_pack.reviews_summary is null.

label.description: Short stat label, e.g. '4.8 stars' or 'Free shipping'.

text.description: One short supporting phrase, e.g. 'from 1,200+ reviews'.

reasons.description: 5-7 numbered reasons, in order (named 'reasons', not 'items' -- 'items' collides with Python dict's own .items method under Jinja's attribute-then-subscript lookup). Each entry: number, an H2 title (<=10 words), a 40-90 word body, one image slot, and claim_ids for any fact stated in it. Proof lives inside each entry -- never a separate stacked proof section.

heading.description: H2 title for this reason, <=10 words, no numeral (the renderer draws the number).

cta_text.description: The ONE CTA button text for this page, from allowed_cta_texts. The renderer reuses it verbatim after item 3 and again at the close -- choose it once here, never vary it.

cta_url.description: The CTA's destination URL, reused everywhere cta_text is.

closing.description: Closing block: 1 paragraph naming Peak, the fixed warranty sentence, and the fixed no-lender financing sentence.

headline.description: Optional short closing-band headline above the paragraph, e.g. 'Ready to feel the difference?'. Never contains a price.

warranty_line.description: Must be exactly the fixed warranty sentence -- see the global voice block.

financing_line.description: Must be exactly 'Financing is available at checkout.' while no lender is configured -- see the global voice block.
